description: This file defines an interface class 'IEventHandler' within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The interface declares callback methods for handling various OCI Container events, each accepting a container name and a JsonObject for event data.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: Interface class for handling OCI Container events. Declares virtual methods to be implemented for reacting to container start, stop, failure, and state change events.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Called when an OCI container starts; provides container name and event data sample.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Called when an OCI container stops; provides container name and event data sample.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Called when an OCI container fails; provides container name and event data sample.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Called when the OCI container changes state; provides container name and event data sample.
